tests.title: Life-detection limits and drilling for life underground in near-sterile, dry soil
tests.detail: Done before at analog sites: NASA ARADS rover + 2 m drill, Atacama (2016–19); Viking-style tests found almost no organics in Atacama's dry core (Navarro-González et al., *Science* 2003)
